snippet.title: Breathedge 2 — Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Breathedge 2 is launching in Early Access! 
The Outskirts await. Explore yet more wreckage of civilization, survive in the vacuum of space, scavenge useful junk, and try not to suffocate before your time.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412960/Breathedge_2/
